cards.title: SNMPwalk
cards.description_short: Query SNMP devices for system information
cards.description_long: SNMPwalk is used to query devices running the Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP). It retrieves information such as system details, running services, network interfaces, and device configurations.

main_commands.explanation: Query SNMP device using community string 'public'
Use SNMP version 1 to retrieve information

activity: Understand risks of default SNMP community strings

cards.title: Gobuster
cards.description_short: Directory, DNS, and virtual host brute forcing tool
cards.description_long: Gobuster is used to discover hidden directories, files, DNS subdomains, and virtual hosts by brute forcing using wordlists. It is commonly used during web application enumeration.

main_commands.explanation: Brute force directories on a website

activity: Discover hidden directories on a web server
Analyze discovered paths for potential vulnerabilities

cards.title: Dirb
cards.description_short: Web content scanner for hidden directories
cards.description_long: Dirb is a web content scanner that uses wordlists to find hidden directories and files on web servers. It helps identify unlinked pages and resources that may expose sensitive data.

main_commands.explanation: Save scan results to a file

activity: Scan a website for hidden directories

cards.title: Nikto
cards.description_long: Nikto scans web servers for vulnerabilities such as outdated software, insecure files, misconfigurations, and dangerous scripts. It helps identify weaknesses in web server setups.

main_commands.explanation: Scan a web server for vulnerabilities
Save scan results to a file

activity: Scan a web server for vulnerabilities
Identify outdated or insecure server components
Analyze dangerous scripts or files found
Compare findings with manual enumeration results
